reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: Section 13.1 sets a single term running until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term with no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic, and Section 14.4 expressly disclaims any renewal or extension by continued dealing.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals.
The failed deterministic check ('notice window number not found') is consistent with the absence of any auto-renewal mechanic rather than evidence of a defect.

Treating Ono (the licensee) as our party is consistent with the alias list, and the perpetual, fully paid-up, royalty-free post-expiry licences plus Ono's unilateral termination-without-cause right make the outcome at least as favourable as the preferred position; no actionable deviation exists.
Rationale correctly notes the outcome sits at or above the preferred position rather than merely at the fallback, so no over-flagging risk.
